{{Infobox Species |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Mountain Buck Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Mountain Buck Model.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |era= [[Era of the Wilds]] |habitat= {{Spawn Locations}} |attack= |weapon= |cost= |value= |characteristics= |members= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Mountain Buck|Mountain Bucks|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}} are recurring [[Creature]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite|'''Mountain Buck'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}{{Cite|'''Mountain Buck'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}} ==Characteristics== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Mountain Buck}} Mountain Bucks are large male [[Mountain Deer]] covered in shaggy brown fur speckled with light spots along the back. They are male counterparts to [[Mountain Doe]]s.{{Cite|These male deer are usually found deep in the forest. They're well known for their huge, branching antlers, which they'll swing in self- defense if threatened. Deer are cautious by nature so it can be tricky getting close, but if you can capture one, you may be able to take it for a ride.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} They can easily be distinguished from them by the large antlers that adorn their heads, which they will swing in self-defense if provoked. Bucks can be found in deciduous forests throughout [[Hyrule]], usually in the accompaniment of three or four Mountain Does. The [[Hyrule Compendium]] notes [[Hyrule Field]] and the [[Lanayru Great Spring]] as areas where Mountain Bucks are common, but in actuality they are native to most [[Region]]s, including [[Necluda]], [[Faron (Region)|Faron]], and [[Akkala]]. Despite their size, Mountain Bucks are skittish [[Creature]]s, and they will run away when they spot [[Link]] nearby. When idle, Bucks can be seen grazing and may even lie down to rest. If Link is [[Stealth]]y enough, he may be able to mount and ride a Mountain Buck. Though fast, their utility is limited. They cannot be registered at a [[Stable]], as the owner will claim they only offer this for [[Horse]]s.{{Cite|Looks like you've caught yourself a new steed! Do you want to register it? Not a problem. Let me just— Oh, for the love of Hylia... That's not a horse! We only board horses here, stranger. No exceptions.|Tasseren|BotW}} When they are killed, Mountain Bucks drop [[Raw Prime Meat]]. At the [[Hateno Pasture]] in [[Hateno Village]], [[Dantz]] operates the [[Deer Hunting]] [[Mini-Game]]. He tasks Link with hunting as many of the Mountain Bucks in [[Retsam Forest]] as he can in one minute, since they are becoming overpopulated.{{Cite|So what I need is for you to hunt some {{Color BotW|Red|deer}} out in {{Color BotW|Blue|Retsam Forest}}. They're overpopulated these days, and it's destroying the forest. That's why I was hoping you could hunt all the {{Color BotW|Red|deer}} you can...in {{Color BotW|Red|one minute}}.|Dantz|BotW}} When Link completes this Mini-Game, Dantz will reward him with [[Rupee]]s.{{Cite|Thanks for doing your part! Here's a reward for you...|Dantz|BotW}}{{Cite|You're downright vicious with that bow, wanderer! Here's a reward for you...|Dantz|BotW}}{{Cite|I knew you were a go-getter, but this is more than I ever dreamed of! Here's a reward for you...|Dantz|BotW}}{{Cite|You got 10 deer?! Easy there, wanderer. I didn't think I'd be saying this, but there's such a thing as being TOO good a hunter. I won't skimp on it this time!|Dantz|BotW}} A Mountain Buck plays an instrumental role in "[[The Crowned Beast]]" [[Shrine Quest]] on [[Rabia Plain]]. There, [[Kass]] will sing an "[[Ancient Song]]" that describes placing a beast with a "crown of bone" upon its throne.{{Cite|A beast that wears a crown of bone,
Prancing through the lush green.
Mount the beast upon its throne,
For only then the shrine is seen.|Kass|BotW}} When Link rides a Mountain Buck onto the [[Pedestal]] nearby, it will turn blue, causing [[Mezza Lo Shrine]] to emerge from the ground nearby.{{Cite|The beast wearing a crown of bone was a mountain buck.

As the song instructed, being atop a mountain buck while it stood on the pedestal caused the shrine to appear.|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Mountain Buck}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Trivia== * The Mountain Buck is one of nine rideable [[Animal]]s in {{BotW|-}}, with the other eight being the [[Horse]], the [[Giant Horse]], the [[White Horse]], the [[Lord of the Mountain]], the Mountain Doe, the [[Stalhorse]], the [[Honeyvore Bear]], and the [[Grizzlemaw Bear]]. ** Of these mounts, the Mountain Buck is one of six that cannot be registered at a Stable. * The Mountain Buck and the Mountain Doe are the only creatures to have gender-specific entries in the Hyrule Compendium. * The Mountain Buck is painted on the main body of the [[Emblazoned Shield]]. * The Mountain Buck strikingly resembles and is likely based on the male {{wp|sika deer}}, a large Japanese forest-dwelling deer with massive antlers and spots. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Link Riding Deer Model.png|Link riding a Mountain Buck from {{BotW|-}} File:BotW Mountain Buck Concept Artwork.jpg|Concept art of a Mountain Buck from {{BotW|-}} File:BotW E3 Trailer Forest Area.png|A Mountain Buck among Mountain Does from the E3 2016 {{BotW|-}} trailer ==See Also== {{See Also| * Animal * Creature * Deer * Mountain Deer * Mountain Doe * Tabantha Moose }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Creatures, Animals, Mammals |species= BotW, TotK }}
